integration_contract.identity: Keep GitHub numeric repository ID as Hypergraph canonical node identity; map to memory engine canonical clone URL/hash without replacing provider ID.
integration_contract.evidence: Import memory engine candidate dependency records only with source and target commit SHA, file path, blob SHA, relation and confidence.
integration_contract.trust: Candidate remains candidate; source review may become reviewed; verified requires reproducible contract/runtime evidence.
integration_contract.governance: Reference System contract IDs and authority declarations; do not fork or duplicate canonical contract authority.
integration_contract.projection: Hypergraph V3 is a read model / cross-repository projection in the umbrella repository, not a new runtime or new repository.
